_comment: DEV/TEST-ONLY firm directory. Read by server/utils/firmsDirectory.js ONLY when MySQL is unavailable and NODE_ENV is not production. These firms are INVENTED for local testing so the hub screens can be seen populated; none of them is real, and the brand names are examples only. The ids here must match data/dev-firm-membership.json exactly — tests/unit/devFirmMembership.test.js fails the build if one drifts from the other.
_shape: Three global groups (brands), three groups (countries) in each, three firms in each country = 27 firms. This is the cascade the tier hubs exist to show: a mentor sees all 27, a global group manager sees their brand's 9, a group manager sees their country's 3.
